free_tier.stated: $3 of credits each month on a $0 plan, 3 concurrent browsers, 1 sandbox or desktop and a 1-hour maximum session; credits refill monthly, do not roll over and spending stops at the balance

per_object_cap.notes: a sandbox has a disk ceiling rather than an object cap; the card does not carry it

retention.notes: Disk durability across instance stops and deletions is not documented.

egress.terms: no transfer allowance or per-GB egress price is stated on the pricing page; snapshots bill at $0.05 per GB-month with the first 10 GB free, and browser proxies bill per GB on paid plans and are not available on Free

interface_detail: a REST HTTP API at api.getsolari.com with a bearer API key and SDKs for TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust and C++; browser sessions are driven over Playwright or CDP WebSockets

limits.value: $3 of monthly credits on Free, drawn at $0.15 per browser-hour or $0.0525 per vCPU-hour and $0.0165 per GB-hour for sandboxes
a free session is capped at 1 hour and replay is kept 1 day
3 concurrent browsers and 3 profiles on Free; human-verification handling and proxies are not available

limits_note: Session cap, idle-reap and network policy are not documented.

identity_cost.detail: the sign-up page states 'Free to start. No card. Pay only for what you use.' and offers a $30 credit with a work email; the console sign-up requires an account and no card; the API uses a console API key as a bearer token

reliability_note: no reliability event recorded in the source passes
